info.title: Slugger CLI: random name generator, Docker and Heroku style
info.description: The slugger command: human-readable random names, Docker- and Heroku-style (humming_dirac, silvery-mud-7643), for containers, git branches and test data. A .NET tool. Not a slugifier.

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --version
options.description: Prints version information

options.name: --theme
options.description:
Theme to draw from (default:
slugger). Repeatable or
comma-separated; '*' for every theme
available

options.name: --theme-dir
options.description:
Where registered themes live
(default: ~/.slugger/themes)

options.name: --sep
options.description:
What joins the terms, whatever the
casing. A single character, or ""
for nothing (default: the casing's
own: - for kebab, _ for snake and
constant, nothing for camel and
pascal)

options.name: --word-sep
options.description:
What joins the words of a multi-word
term. A single character, or "" to
glue them (default: the separator)

options.name: --casing
options.description:
kebab, snake, camel, constant or
pascal (default: kebab). Sets the
capitals, and what joins the terms
unless --sep says otherwise

options.name: --segment
options.description:
What precedes the noun: adjective,
participle, either, both or
threeOrTwo (default: both).
participle needs a theme with at
least 100 participles per noun, as
docker has; the other shipped themes
are refused in that mode

options.name: --max-length
options.description:
Longest slug allowed, in characters.
Leaves out the words that would not
fit; never truncates

options.name: --max-segment-words
options.description:
Most words a term may hold, or
'none'. Leaves out longer terms;
never splits one. 'none' also lifts
a cap set by the theme's style

options.name: --token-length
options.description:
Length of the trailing token
(default: 0, no token)

options.name: --token-chance
options.description:
How many slugs out of 100 get a
token (default: 100)

options.name: --count
options.description:
How many slugs one round generates
(default: 1)

options.name: --seed
options.description: Seed for a reproducible run

options.name: --fold-accents
options.description:
Strip the accents that can be
stripped, keeping the base letter

options.name: --ascii
options.description:
Force an ASCII slug, even if it
mangles the words

options.name: --token-hex
options.description:
Draw the token in hexadecimal rather
than decimal

options.name: --token-glued
options.description:
Glue the token to the previous
segment, with no separator

options.name: --oneshot
options.description:
Generate once and quit. Without it,
a terminal stays open: Enter draws
again, Ctrl+D quits

options.name: --clipboard
options.description:
Copy the last slug to the clipboard
(needs xsel on Linux)

options.name: --allow-small-theme
options.description:
Waive the minimum size rules for
this run

options.name: --mimic-style
options.description:
Whether the drawn theme's own style
applies (default: yes for one theme,
no for several). Without a value,
means true

options.name: --list-themes
options.description: List the themes available and quit

options.name: --init
options.description:
Save the other options of this
command line as your defaults, and
quit

options.name: --register
options.description:
Validate a theme file and copy it
into the theme directory

options.name: --unregister
options.description: Remove a registered theme

options.name: --analyze
options.description:
Measure a theme file and write the
report next to it

options.name: --theme-info
options.description:
Show a theme's own metadata - title,
description, version, author, source
- and quit
